qa_pairs.question: Is the changing trend from 2018 - 2024E in 'Market Size and Forecast of China's Gift Economy' consistent with the changing trend of the proportion of people with a New Year gift budget of 4,000 - 5,000 yuan from 2023 - 2024 in 'Budget Distribution of the Public for New Year Gifts'? Please answer yes or no.
qa_pairs.explanation: The market size continues to rise, and the proportion of people with a New Year gift budget of 4,000 - 5,000 yuan rises from 17% to 19%. Both show an upward trend.

qa_pairs.question: Is the age group with the highest proportion of gift - givers in 'Age - cohort Distribution of New Year Gift - giving Population' the same as the age group with the highest number of information - acquisition channel combinations? Answer yes or no.
qa_pairs.explanation: The former is the Post - 90s (25%), and the latter is the Post - 00s and Post - 95s (3.8).

qa_pairs.question: Is the numerical trend of the TGI of giving health gifts from the 'Pre - 70s' to the 'Post - 85s' in 'Age - cohort Distribution of New Year Gift - giving Population' consistent with the numerical trend of the proportion of people corresponding to the New Year gift budget from '<1,000 yuan' to '3,000 - 4,000 yuan' in 'Budget Distribution of the Public for New Year Gifts' in 2024? Answer yes or no.
qa_pairs.explanation: From the 'Pre - 70s' to the 'Post - 85s' (from the oldest to the youngest age groups), the numerical value of the TGI of giving health gifts continues to rise (93 - 97 - 99 - 103 - 106). The numerical value of the proportion of people corresponding to the New Year gift budget from '<1,000 yuan' to '3,000 - 4,000 yuan' also rises continuously (4% - 15% - 18% - 25%).

qa_pairs.question: Assuming that the contribution of each age cohort to the market size of China's gift economy is the same as the distribution ratio of the age cohorts of the gift - giving population, what is the contribution of the Post - 90s to the market size of China's gift economy in 2020? In trillions of yuan, rounded to three decimal places.
qa_pairs.explanation: The market size of the gift economy in 2020 was 1.10 trillion yuan, and the Post - 90s contributed 25%, which is 0.275 trillion yuan.

qa_pairs.question: If it is estimated that a total of 50 million people plan to give New Year gifts in 2024, and most of the people with a budget of 4000 yuan or more are considered to be in the 'consumption upgrade' group, what is the total number of people participating in the survey of consumption attitudes towards New Year gift - giving? In millions of people, rounded to the nearest integer.
qa_pairs.explanation: The proportion of people with a budget of 4000 yuan or more is 38% (obtained by adding up the proportions of each range). The total number of people is 50 million, so the number of people in the consumption upgrade group can be considered as 50 million × 0.38 = 19 million. The total number of people is 19 million / 42% = 45.24 million people.

qa_pairs.question: If the total number of gift - giving people in the country is 90 million, what is the approximate total number of times the Post - 90s group uses gift information channels? In millions of times, rounded to the nearest integer.
qa_pairs.explanation: The number of Post - 90s is 90 million × 25% = 22.5 million; on average, each person uses 3.7 channels, so the total number of times is 22.5 million × 3.7 = 83.25 million times.

answer.A: Design bundled promotional activities for shopping festivals (such as Double 11 and 618). Since the proportion of gift - giving during these festivals is relatively low but has potential to be explored, combined with the attitude of some consumers who are more willing to spend on special occasions, stimulate incremental purchases through discounts.
answer.B: Design gifts that emphasize practicality and cost - effectiveness for Father's Day and Mother's Day (with a 76% proportion). Since the attention to practicality in New Year gift purchases is 70%, it can meet the needs of most consumers.
answer.C: Prioritize the development of gifts for traditional festivals (such as the Spring Festival and Mid - Autumn Festival). Since these festivals dominate the gift - giving scenarios, and consumers highly value the health attributes when purchasing New Year gifts, launch themed gift boxes integrating health elements to capture the core needs.
answer.D: Enhance user stickiness through customer loyalty programs and membership systems, thereby indirectly promoting gift sales.
answer.E: Prioritize investing in marketing activities for Christmas and New Year's Day (with a 53% proportion). Launch luxury gift combinations. Since the proportion of consumption upgrade is as high as 42%, it can effectively attract high - end consumers.
answer.F: Strengthen brand promotion across all channels and on social media to enhance the overall brand influence and stimulate sales growth throughout the year.
answer.G: Launch gift combinations that emphasize practicality and cost - effectiveness on romantic festivals such as Valentine's Day and Qixi Festival. qa_pairs.question: According to the characteristics of the New Year gift - giving population and consumption attitudes, how should enterprises design New Year gifts to maximize market acceptance? Please select the most effective suggestion.

answer.A: Focus on developing gifts with prominent health attributes and gift - box packaging. Since health is the most concerned factor for consumers when giving gifts, and the demand for hassle - free packaging is significant, combined with the relatively high preference index of the older group for health gifts, it can cover multiple age groups.
answer.B: Develop gifts using sustainable materials and environmentally friendly designs to respond to the global environmental protection trend and enhance the corporate social image.
answer.C: Provide flexible budget options (such as different price ranges). Since the distribution of New Year gift spending is wide, and most consumers tend to maintain the same consumption level, this strategy can take into account people with different payment abilities.
answer.D: Specifically design high - end health gifts for the Post - 00s group. Since their health TGI reaches 105 (slightly higher than the average), and the proportion of the budget in the 5 - 8k range increased to 13% in 2024, it can effectively attract young high - spending consumers.
answer.E: Design cost - effective and practical gifts for young groups (such as the Post - 00s and Post - 95s). Since their proportion in the gift - giving population is increasing significantly, but their budgets are mostly concentrated in the medium range, avoid over - emphasizing the precious attributes to match their consumption habits.
answer.F: Increase cooperation with online shopping platforms and optimize logistics to ensure the convenience of gift delivery, thereby enhancing the overall consumer experience.
answer.G: Reduce low - price gift options (such as ≤1k). Since the proportion of consumption downgrade is only 8%, enterprises should focus on mid - to high - end gifts (such as 3 - 5k) to maximize profits and meet the face - saving needs.
